sources.title: UlamAI Prover: An Open Lean 4 Theorem Prover - Ulam Blog
sources.snippet: Most capable AI theorem provers are closed systems: proprietary models behind proprietary infrastructure, with results you can read about but can't reproduce. UlamAI Prover is different. The entire codebase—search loop, retrieval, repair logic, Lean runner, trace logging—is open-source and available on GitHub. This matters for two reasons.

sources.title: Reasoning Data and Evaluations | Ulam
sources.snippet: Ulam builds research-grade reasoning datasets, human-in-the-loop traces, and private benchmarks and evaluations for frontier AI labs and AI developers.
